name: AnthroArm-27
description: Human-shaped shoulder, upper arm, forearm, wrist and independently articulated five-digit hand. Digital engineering concept.
coordinate_convention: Link local +Z points distally, +X is palmar, +Y is thumb/index side. Shoulder anchor rotates pi around X in world, so neutral arm hangs down.

links.name: base_link

geoms.name: ShoulderMountFlange
geoms.description: Separate four-bolt shoulder attachment flange. It is a fixture interface, not an industrial arm pedestal or a human limb segment. Mounting structure/load rating still require engineering.

links.description: Fixed shoulder anchor. Neutral limb hangs downward; no moving pedestal.

links.name: shoulder_abduction

geoms.name: ShoulderSocket
geoms.description: Rounded shoulder socket establishes the proximal human silhouette. The three shoulder axes are co-located kinematically; internal bearing packaging remains conceptual.

links.description: Glenohumeral flexion/extension axis.

geoms.name: ShoulderRotationCoupler
